content: Yaa imaak
Eemon Maaron maata iŋgalŋgal Noa ve gabua naol isov to su ve nughei tau tileep tomania ila waaŋ loolo na. Tauvene igham yaghur ilaan izala yaa paavo to ivuvuur yaa leso imaak.
Ve taan aavo tau yaa ivotvot pani tomania sambam saamba aavo tau yaa izi pani na, tivool muul, ve uman imot.
Tauta yaa imaak poipoi irau mboŋ 150. Indeeŋ kaiyo imin liim ve ru, ve mboŋ imin saŋavul liim ve ru, waaŋ ilot izala loloz ee to taan Ararat daaba.
Yaa imaak izizi le kaiyo saŋavul, ve mboŋ imin maata, ra loloz dabazi peria.
Mboŋ tamoot ru paam ilam ila, ra Noa ikaak sooso rig tau papazoge ighuru pa yaghur itaghoni na, ve imbaaŋ man kool ee ila. Man tawe ivarovroov le yaa imaak kat.
Noa ighe iwatagh: Yaa imaak wa, ma soone? Tauvene imbaaŋ mbuun ee ila.

Eemon yaa imaak kat soone. Tauvene mbuun tawe irau indeeŋ niia poia eta to mariaoŋ mako, ve iroov imuul ila pa waaŋ. Noa izuzuun niima ivot ila muuri, ve mbuun iroov ilam imbutur izala, ve Noa ighamu iloŋ ila waaŋ loolo muul.
Noa isaŋan le mboŋ liim ve ru isov, ra imbaaŋ mbuun iroov muul ila.
Ila irovroov le ravrav izi, ra iŋaaŋ ai oliv mbiila ee ila dadabu, ve iroov imuul ila pa waaŋ. Tauvene Noa iwatagh ighe yaa imaak wa.
Noa isaŋan le mboŋ liim ve ru muul isov, ra ipul mbuun iroov muul ila. Saawe tana, ila le imuul mako.
Tauvene indeeŋ Noa ndaman tooni irau 601, kaiyo imin maata ve mbooŋi imin maata, ene taan imamaas wa. Tauvene Noa ipas atov siriv pa waaŋ gha itiir nugh, ve ighita taan imamaas.
Indeeŋ kaiyo imin ru, ve mbooŋi imin tamoot ee liim ve ru, taan igorgor kat.
Tauvene Maaron isaav pa Noa ighe: “Yo tomania azuwam, natumŋa, ve rawamlivaŋa, apul waaŋ, ve avot ala muuri.
Ve ugham gabua matazi yaryaare naol tau yamŋa aleep ila waaŋ loolo na tivot tila muuri paam. Leso tilaagh irau taan ve timasa timin naol, ve tileep irau taan muul.”
Tauvene Noa yesuru azaawa, natŋa, ve raulivaŋa tipul waaŋ, ve tivot tila muuri.
Ve ŋgai maata maata, man, gabua naol isov tau tikakarau ila taan, ene tisov tighur zi ila sosoor toz toz, ve tipul waaŋ gha tivot muuri paam.
Noa igham watooŋrau pa Yoova

Ra Noa indou maet imin artaal pa Yoova. Ve ŋgai ve man tisov tau popoiazi pa watooŋrau na, i igham eŋaeŋa ve irav zi timaat. Ra ighur zi tizala artaal paavo gha yav ighan dodolin zi imin watooŋrau pa Yoova.

Yoova inuŋuz watooŋrau tawe vaazi poia kat, ve isaav ila loolo ighe: “Murei, yau aat irau navaghamunia taan pa sosor to tamtamon muul mako. Pasaa, yau nawatagh: Saawe tau yes geegeu ve ilam, ene ŋgar sasaghati igheen ariaaŋ ila lolozi. Tauvene yau aat irau navaghamunia gabua matazi yaryaare muul imin tau aazne naghamu ne mako.

content.text: saawe to vazoghiiŋ aniiŋ, ve saawe to mariri,
saawe to nugh iyauŋ, ve saawe to nugh ituntun,
ragh ve yavaar, mboŋ ve mataaz.
Gabua naol tana irau tisov ne mako.
Pale tighengheen tauvene mon taghon taghon gha ila.”
